status: PROPOSAL (ratings are design judgement; measured basis cites data files)

options.name: Player-visible face relief, current protections
options.measuredBasis: 31.44 ha of A1a-editable faces visible from Birchwood, Central Valley or the route; V1 changed 0 % of those cells
options.visualGain: medium: in-face relief (couloirs, buttresses, shadow lines) on the faces players actually look at; skyline unchanged (0 px)
options.hydrologicalRisk: low: cut-only on open faces, existing divide guard, same A1a validation
options.complexity: low–medium: reuse the A1a face operator, add viewshed targeting and a couloir rhythm, face gate 0.75 → 0.60 on targeted faces

options.name: A1b-α plus summit block with a narrowed trail corridor
options.recommended: second prototype, only if release R-A is granted
options.measuredBasis: corridor ±20 m frees 4–18 % of the route skyline and 15–32 % of route-visible massif cells; release area 2.15 ha above 780 m
options.visualGain: high at player height on the hero ascent; medium from the far approaches
options.hydrologicalRisk: low: cut-only flanks, divide guard; route risk medium, handled by a passability gate
options.complexity: medium: corridor geometry change + tread gate + walk test

options.name: A2 stepped crest raise (+18 m)
options.measuredBasis: skyline shift 4–5 px from Birchwood / Central Valley; 3 px needs ≥ 9–11 m

options.name: Far-silhouette identity through a design-master crest revision
options.measuredBasis: far skylines are 62–82 % R1 crest band; a strong change (≥ 15 px) needs ≥ 50 m at 2.8 km
options.visualGain: high (the only route to a new far silhouette)
options.hydrologicalRisk: high: requires an R1 re-solve, which P0 measured would move about 22 % of mainland cells

options.name: C1 rebuilt as a valley-head cirque in the NE hollow
options.recommended: design accepted for later (A1c); needs a viewpoint
options.measuredBasis: hollow is a real valley only below ~650 m (45–124 m deep, ~500 m wide); 0 % visible from far / route, 0.3 % from High Tarn; 43–51 % from the lower A1 crest
options.visualGain: high geomorphological credibility; low at current player positions
options.hydrologicalRisk: low–medium: sea catchment, cut-only, floor grades out, ravine untouched
options.complexity: high: headwall, floor, lateral rib, secondary couloir, lip; max lowering 83 m
options.authorization: R-D C1 redesign, R-E overlook path

options.name: Cirque on the visible tarn side (A1-D C2-a site)
options.measuredBasis: planar ESE slope, no valley head (0–23 m deep); visible 51.6 % far / 41.2 % High Tarn
options.visualGain: high visibility, but the valley head would have to be invented (decorative risk)
options.hydrologicalRisk: medium–high: High Tarn catchment, saddle fill

options.name: Asymmetric cut-bank gully, tarn-inlet-w s 296–472 m
options.recommended: design accepted for later; calibration only
options.measuredBasis: hillside (north) relief 31–38 m, south bank 4 m, cut room 0–1 m, 100 % visible from High Tarn, 0 % far
options.hydrologicalRisk: low–medium: bed frozen, fill only on the hillside bank, lateral fall to the channel kept

options.name: Gully on tarn-inlet-n s 270–376 m
options.measuredBasis: hillside relief ~31 m, gradient 61 %, visible 64 % far / 100 % High Tarn; next to the D3 frozen head zone

authorizations.change: Narrow the peak-ascent corridor near the summit from ±75 m (+60 m fade) to ±20 m (+20 m fade) above 780 m, with a passability gate (centreline Δ = 0, grade and ±3 m tread cross-slope unchanged, walk test passes)
authorizations.why: the corridor is derived from the design-master route reservation (widthM 150)

authorizations.change: Crest raises on any arête (e.g. A2 step +18 m)
authorizations.why: not approved in A1-D (D1 left towers/raises as an option)

authorizations.change: Design-master crest-profile revision (A-R2) and the R1 re-solve it implies
authorizations.why: design-master edits are a stop condition for A1

authorizations.change: Replace the A1-D C1 geometry with C1-R (floor 655–665 m moved down the hollow, lateral rib, secondary couloir, headwall to the crest band, max lowering ≈ 83 m)
authorizations.why: changes an approved A1-D design element (D2)

authorizations.change: A path or overlook on the lower A1 crest (≈ 760–790 m) so C1-R can be seen at player height
Build a cirque on the tarn side (C2-a)
Move G1 from the middle reach (fraction 0.35–0.65) to s 296–472 m (≈ 0.50–0.79) and release the R1 valley band there; hillside-bank fill up to ≈ 16 m
authorizations.why: D8 fixed G1 to the middle reach
